_note: Recorded GET https://prestocks.com/api/prestocks, fetched once on 22 Sep 2026 while src/lib/assets/prestocks.ts was written. Never refetched inside a test. Eight pre-IPO tokens on Solana mainnet; contract_address is the Token-2022 mint (9 decimals, ScaledUiAmount). markPrice is the issuer SPV mark and tokenPrice the DEX price: two different numbers (NEURALINK traded above its mark that day, SPACEX below), never a discount. Fields the app reads: name, symbol, image, contract_address, markPrice, tokenPrice; description, external_url, markValuation, impliedValuation and supply are passed through untouched.
